name: anomaly_detection
description: Monitors DNS queries across all devices using Suricata eve.json to detect zero-day threats, coordinated multi-device attacks, and behavioral anomalies. Scores incidents by novelty, device spread, timing, and recurrence. Phase 2: auto-generates Claude AI incident reports for HIGH+ incidents (requires ANTHROPIC_API_KEY in nemesis.env), with 24h dedup, 30-day recurrence reuse, configurable rate limits, and manual analysis via AI button.
